authority.resource_observation_policy: select and verify an exact registered resource before each stateful operation
authority.credentials_policy: record credential references only; never commit secret values
authority.local_port_policy: registered ports are fixed for their named environment and have no fallback

tooling.purpose: negative-pattern and repository architecture checks in the aggregate GitHub Actions quality job
tooling.owner: Peanut Admin Core GitHub Actions quality job
tooling.freshness_requirement: download the immutable named asset and verify its registered SHA-256 before installation
tooling.health_check: rg --version reports ripgrep 15.1.0 after the package checksum passes
tooling.lifecycle: one isolated GitHub Actions quality job
tooling.cleanup_responsibility: GitHub disposes the runner after the job

tooling.purpose: exact Composer toolchain for coordinated Core package lock generation and projection checks
tooling.owner: Peanut Admin Core release candidate owner
tooling.service_type: official Composer PHAR and local fixed executable
tooling.freshness_requirement: the fixed local path is either absent or matches the registered SHA-256 and reports Composer 2.10.2 before use
tooling.health_check: shasum -a 256 on the exact local path equals the registered digest and php <path> --version reports Composer 2.10.2
tooling.lifecycle: retained through one coordinated Core release candidate and its clean Composer consumer check
tooling.cleanup_responsibility: the release candidate owner removes only /private/tmp/peanut-admin-core-tools after all dependent checks complete

tooling.purpose: exact Node and pnpm toolchain for coordinated Core workspace lock generation and package checks
tooling.owner: Peanut Admin Core release candidate owner
tooling.data_source: package.json packageManager plus pnpm-lock.yaml and starter/pnpm-lock.yaml
tooling.freshness_requirement: both exact binaries must report the registered versions before changing a workspace lock
tooling.health_check: node --version reports v24.13.0 and pnpm --version reports 11.13.0 from the registered directory

tooling.purpose: offline pnpm content store for focused workspace lock validation
tooling.owner: Peanut Admin Core release candidate owner
tooling.data_source: public packages fixed by pnpm-lock.yaml and starter/pnpm-lock.yaml
tooling.freshness_requirement: pnpm store path must equal the registered path and both lock checks must complete offline; a cache miss blocks instead of enabling network access
tooling.health_check: pnpm --store-dir /Users/xing/Library/pnpm/store/v11 store path returns the same path
tooling.cleanup_responsibility: the task removes only worktree-local dependency links and temporary outputs; it never deletes the shared store

local_listeners.purpose: generated internal Starter backend HTTP verification in GitHub Actions
local_listeners.owner: Peanut Admin Core GitHub Actions workflow job
local_listeners.service_type: PHP built-in HTTP server for the generated internal Starter
local_listeners.version: PHP 8.3 selected by the consuming workflow
local_listeners.data_source: generated internal Starter from the checked-out Core commit
local_listeners.freshness_requirement: the loopback port must be unbound before scripts/verify-internal-starter starts the server
local_listeners.health_check: GET http://127.0.0.1:20280/health returns the generated Starter health response
local_listeners.cleanup_responsibility: scripts/verify-internal-starter terminates its exact child process; GitHub disposes the runner after the job

local_listeners.purpose: generated internal Starter frontend preview verification in GitHub Actions
local_listeners.owner: Peanut Admin Core GitHub Actions workflow job
local_listeners.service_type: Vite preview for the generated internal Starter
local_listeners.version: Vite version fixed by the generated Starter lock
local_listeners.data_source: generated internal Starter from the checked-out Core commit
local_listeners.freshness_requirement: the loopback port must be unbound before scripts/verify-internal-starter starts the preview
local_listeners.health_check: the starter verifier observes the preview URL and receives a successful HTTP response from http://127.0.0.1:20281/
local_listeners.cleanup_responsibility: scripts/verify-internal-starter terminates its exact child process; GitHub disposes the runner after the job

external_services.purpose: Core source control, pull requests, immutable annotated tags and GitHub prereleases
external_services.credential_ref: developer gh/SSH credential provider and GitHub environment npm-release/NPM_TOKEN metadata; secret values are never read or printed
external_services.freshness_requirement: fetch dev and prove the target tag and Release are absent before candidate preparation or publication
external_services.health_check: git ls-remote origin refs/heads/dev plus read-only gh repository and workflow metadata

external_services.purpose: generated-only Composer projection publication and immutable tag verification
external_services.data_source: the exact packages/php projection from one qualified source commit
external_services.freshness_requirement: prove the target tag is absent and the projection commit tree matches the qualified packages/php subtree before tagging

external_services.purpose: immutable @peanut-admin/admin publication and clean npm consumer verification
external_services.owner: npm public registry; peanut-opensource package publisher
external_services.credential_ref: GitHub environment peanut-opensource/peanut-admin-core/npm-release secret NPM_TOKEN; token values are never printed or stored in Git
external_services.data_source: the immutable source tag published by .github/workflows/release.yml with provenance
external_services.freshness_requirement: prove the exact version is absent and the environment secret name exists before the source tag is created; verify version, integrity and provenance after publication
external_services.health_check: npm view @peanut-admin/admin@<exact-version> plus gh secret list --env npm-release without secret values

external_services.purpose: immutable peanut-admin/core metadata refresh and clean Composer consumer verification
external_services.credential_ref: operator-authenticated Packagist maintainer session; credentials and session material are never stored in Git
external_services.data_source: the immutable generated Composer split tag refreshed by an authenticated maintainer
external_services.freshness_requirement: prove the split tag and projection identity before refresh; after refresh resolve the exact version and retain its source/dist reference
external_services.health_check: read-only https://repo.packagist.org/p2/peanut-admin/core.json followed by authenticated package ownership verification before refresh
